topics.name: Deformation, folds, faults and geological maps

questions.question: 1(a)(iii)

questions.summary: Describe three likely differences between rock in a metamorphic aureole and the unaltered sandstone.

questions.question: 1(c)(ii)

questions.question: 2(a)(i)
questions.summary: State which seismic wave, P or S, travels fastest, using time/distance curves.

questions.question: 2(b)(i)
questions.summary: Describe how P wave velocity changes from the surface to 670 km depth.

questions.question: 2(b)(ii)

questions.summary: Draw and label three Earth boundaries on a velocity-depth graph.
